title: Integral henselian restriction to the residue-field fibre
statement: Let A be a henselian local ring, Λ a commutative ring, p : Z → Spec A integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], F an etale sheaf of Λ-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and (i₀,p₀,p,Spec(A → A/m_A)) Cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Then restriction Γ(Z,F) → Γ(Z₀,i₀*F) is injective. No separably closed residue field, finite type, torsion or nonempty scheme assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 09XK, combined with Etale Cohomology Tag 0A0C

proof.text: Since p is integral over an affine base, Z is affine. Put B = Γ(Z,⊤), φ = (ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫ p.appTop, and use φ to give B its A-algebra structure. The identity Z.toSpecΓ ≫ p.steinFactorizationBase = p, cancellation of the affine isomorphism, and IsIntegralHom.SpecMap_iff show that this algebra is integral. Set J = (maximalIdeal A).map φ.hom. Apply henselianRing_of_isIntegral to the henselian pair (A,maximalIdeal A), obtaining HenselianRing B J.

CommRingCat.isPushout_quotient φ (maximalIdeal A), followed by isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout and flip, gives the Cartesian square with upper map j : Spec(B/J) → Spec B. Transport the given square along Z.isoSpec. The two pullback universal properties give e : Z₀ ≅ Spec(B/J), with e.hom ≫ j ≫ Z.isoSpec.inv = i₀. The residue field and residue map are definitionally the maximal-ideal quotient and quotient map. This is only the standard tensor-quotient pullback identification; the cited upstream pushout lemma is proved.

Let G be the inverse image of F along Z.isoSpec.inv. Apply isIso_globalSectionsUpperStarMap_of_henselianRing Λ J to the proper identity of Spec B, with fibre j and structure map the identity of Spec(B/J). Its Cartesian square is IsPullback.of_vert_isIso. Hence restriction along j is an isomorphism.

Apply globalSectionsUpperStarMap_comp first to e.hom and j, then to e.hom ≫ j and Z.isoSpec.inv. Section pullback along each scheme isomorphism is an isomorphism, as is the global-sections image of each upperStarComp isomorphism. Cancel these composition isomorphisms using IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right. Rewrite e.hom ≫ j ≫ Z.isoSpec.inv = i₀ to conclude that restriction along i₀ is an isomorphism. ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso gives injectivity. All arguments include B=0 without a nonemptiness hypothesis.

theorem integralHenselianClosedFibreSections_injective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    {Z Z₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsIntegralHom p]
    (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ Z) (p₀ : Z₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (sq : IsPullback i₀ p₀ p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A))))
    (F : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Function.Injective (globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i₀ F).hom
